# Albatross flight energetics

Dynamic soaring allows albatrosses to extract energy from wind gradients. Wing loading influences glide efficiency, while GPS tracks reveal repeated crosswind arcs. Stronger near-surface wind can reduce flapping effort. Researchers estimate travel cost from heart-rate and accelerometer measurements. Long-distance routes are therefore linked to wind structure, wing morphology, and energy expenditure.

# Mangrove salinity and blue carbon

Mangrove sediment stores substantial blue carbon. Salinity gradients alter seedling growth, pore-water chemistry, and microbial decomposition. Field plots compare low-, medium-, and high-salinity zones. Soil organic carbon is measured by depth, and tidal inundation affects carbon burial. The study connects salt stress, sediment processes, biomass allocation, and coastal carbon sequestration.

# Perovskite solar-cell stability

Moisture and thermal cycling accelerate degradation in perovskite solar cells. Encapsulation slows water ingress, while ion migration contributes to current-voltage hysteresis. Researchers monitor power-conversion efficiency during damp-heat ageing. Interface passivation can reduce non-radiative recombination. Operational stability therefore depends on humidity barriers, temperature, interfaces, and mobile ions.

# Diet intervention and gut microbiome

A high-fibre dietary intervention can increase microbial diversity and short-chain fatty-acid production. Longitudinal stool samples are analysed with amplicon sequencing. Antibiotic exposure is treated as an important confounder. Mixed-effects models separate within-person change from baseline differences. The evidence links dietary fibre, community composition, butyrate production, and repeated measurements.

# Seismic velocity inversion

Travel-time tomography estimates subsurface seismic velocity from source-receiver observations. Regularization stabilizes the inverse problem, and checkerboard tests assess spatial resolution. Low-velocity anomalies may indicate fractured or fluid-rich zones. Uncertainty depends on ray coverage and picking error. The workflow connects arrival times, velocity models, resolution tests, and geological interpretation.

# Lithium battery electrolyte safety

Fluorinated electrolyte additives can promote a stable solid-electrolyte interphase in lithium-metal batteries. Coulombic efficiency is measured across repeated plating and stripping cycles. Dendrite growth raises short-circuit risk, while high salt concentration changes solvent coordination. Cryogenic microscopy reveals interphase morphology. Battery safety depends on electrolyte formulation, interphase chemistry, and cycling stability.
